name: Academic-Instability-Early-Warning-System
description: 📊 Detect academic fragility early with this analytics engine that identifies instability before grades reveal the problem.

paragraphs: The Academic Instability Early Warning System is an interpretable engine designed to detect signs of academic instability before grades drop. Instead of just predicting outcomes, it models factors like pressure buildup, buffer strength, and transition risk. By analyzing attendance, engagement, and study load, the system explains weaknesses and pinpoints effective interventions.
features: Early Detection: Identify risks before they turn into significant issues.
Data-Driven Insights: Provides a clear picture of how factors impact student performance.
User-Friendly Interface: Easy to navigate, even for those without technical skills.
Visualizations: Presents data in an understandable format through charts and graphs.
Customizable Settings: Adjust parameters to tailor insights to specific needs.
